hook: Natalia Panferova compares SwiftUI's scroll-driven effect APIs
hookText: Natalia Panferova compares SwiftUI's scroll-driven effect APIs

beats.say: A Nil Coalescing guide to when to use scrollTransition, visualEffect, onScrollGeometryChange and onScrollVisibilityChange for effects tied to scroll position in SwiftUI.
The post shows examples of each and how to choose between them. SwiftUI provides several ways to tie the appearance of content to its position as the user scrolls.
The scrollTransition modifier applies an effect to a view as it enters and leaves the visible region of a scroll view.
